variants.name: harbor-wall-v2
variants.prompt: Correct the anatomy and physical staging of the attached wide fantasy group banner. Preserve the four faces, hairstyles, outfit designs, left-to-right identities Gawain, Freya, Guinevere, Fenrir and the beautiful Gwynthor coastal panorama. References 2–5 are the original identity portraits, which must remain faithful. Keep 3:1 panoramic landscape, same warm Tales of Xillia/Frieren anime lineart and cel shading. Rebuild the poses cleanly: exactly FOUR human adults, each one anatomically coherent connected head-neck-torso-pelvis, exactly two arms with one hand each, no duplicate limbs. Place ALL FOUR STANDING ON THE SAME FLAT TERRACE IN FRONT OF a low stone wall BEHIND them. No one sits on the wall, raises a knee, crosses legs, emerges from masonry or places any leg on the wall. Frame naturally from upper thighs upward, with visible connected waists, belts and hips; no ambiguous masonry crossing through their bodies. The wall is a simple background horizontal line behind their hips, not in front of any body. Leave a small clear gap between adjacent bodies and hands. They still look relaxed, candid and amused at each other, not at attention, no formal lineup. Freya has exactly TWO arms: her right forearm and hand rest naturally on the lute body, her left arm ends in one hand holding its neck; no extra hand at her waist. Guinevere has a normal connected slim torso and hips, feet firmly on the terrace outside the frame; she does NOT sit, perch, kneel or raise a leg. Fenrir is a HUMAN MAN, not a wolf. Preserve sweeping city, coastline, harbor, sea, sunset and surrounding landscape. No labels, writing, border or watermark. Gawain leans one shoulder lightly against a separate stone post with an easy grin, both arms relaxed and visibly his own. Freya laughs while loosely holding her lute. Guinevere stands comfortably with one hand resting on her own belt and the other at her own side, amused sideways glance toward Gawain. Fenrir stands with one hand on his own belt and the other resting flat on the wall BEHIND him, shoulders loose, friendly smile. Simple readable independent silhouettes and plausible contact points.

variants.name: coastal-walk
variants.prompt: Create ONE wide panoramic fantasy anime banner, THREE TO ONE landscape aspect ratio, Tales of Xillia/Frieren clear lineart and clean cel shading, simple illustrated textures and warm coastal light. Image 1 is the previous banner: retain the four identities, outfits and Gwynthor coastal city, but completely change their poses into a candid relaxed scene. Images 2–5 clarify Gawain (long red hair, blue eyes, dark dragon armor and red scarf), Freya (long golden blonde hair, brown eyes, blue and gold, lute), Guinevere (auburn bob, blue-green eyes, black/gold serpent archer gear, cream cape), Fenrir (tall HUMAN MAN, tousled blonde hair, blue eyes, light chin stubble, grey fur collar, red wolf armor). Exactly these FOUR ADULT HUMAN companions, naturally proportioned, no chibi, all faces visible. Their familiar equipment remains but they are at ease, friendly and genuinely interacting rather than facing the viewer in a formal lineup. Gwynthor's broad coastal panorama remains recognizable and expansive: pale medieval walls and towers, red-brown roofs, high castle against hills, cathedral, river channels, stone bridges, harbor and blue-green sea. Group and beautiful sweeping city/coast in one continuous scene, no panel divisions, words, borders, captions or watermarks. Variant: the four walk together shoulder to shoulder along a grassy coastal path above Gwynthor, caught mid-conversation. Gawain gestures animatedly telling a funny story, Freya smiles up at him with her lute slung safely at her side, Guinevere turns her head toward the others with a mischievous amused grin, Fenrir walks with one hand casually resting on his travel bag strap, a small relaxed smile. Natural varied arm and leg positions, casual strolling pace, breeze moving cloaks, not marching or saluting. Camera eye level, landscape and harbor stretching far behind and to the right.
